variant.name: kind-aware-minimal
variant.hypothesis: Route routine command and code-orientation requests to compact views while reserving full text for exact edits, copying, or broad detail review.

prompts.viewInstructions: A coding agent working on `task` just called `agent.tool` with `agent.args` (its reasoning right before the call is `agent.text_before_call`). Choose the smallest view that supports the next step. For routine command results, prefer `signals` or `head_tail`; for code, prefer `outline`, `focus`, or `relevant` when the task names specific code. Choose `full` only when exact text, broad details, copying, quoting, or an edit may depend on omitted content. When uncertain between compact views, choose the one that preserves the named identifiers and likely next-step evidence.

variant.name: code-behavior-relevant
variant.hypothesis: Prefer relevant over narrow code views when the task names an implementation or behavior, reducing identifier misses while retaining compact command views.

prompts.viewInstructions: A coding agent working on `task` just called `agent.tool` with `agent.args` (its reasoning right before the call is `agent.text_before_call`). Choose the smallest view that supports the next step. For routine command results, prefer `signals` or `head_tail`. For code, use `relevant` when the task names an implementation, behavior, or identifier the agent may need to understand or change; use `focus` only to locate explicitly named symbols, and `outline` for broad structure. Choose `full` only when exact text, broad details, copying, quoting, or an edit may depend on omitted content. When uncertain, preserve the named identifiers and likely next-step evidence.
